subject: general
question: Which of the following statements regarding fertilizers is FALSE?

options.text: Leaches out with rains or irrigation water
Nutrient amounts calculated in advance can be applied

solution:
The correct answer is __**option 3**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Fertilizers must be properly stored** to prevent moisture absorption, caking, and degradation of nutrients.
 
• **Fertilizers can leach out** with rains or irrigation water, leading to nutrient loss and potential contamination of groundwater.
 
• It is **false** that fertilizers **never contaminate air and water**. Improper use of fertilizers can lead to nutrient runoff into water bodies, causing eutrophication, and can release gases like ammonia and nitrous oxide into the air.
 
• **Nutrient amounts calculated in advance can be applied** to meet the specific needs of crops, optimizing growth and yield while minimizing waste and environmental impact.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Pedology** is a branch of soil science focusing on the formation, morphology, and classification of soils as bodies within the natural landscape. It is another term for **Soil Geography**.
 
• Pedology studies how global landforms, biogeochemical conditions, and living organism habitats have evolved together with the characteristics and patterns of soil distribution.
 
• Pedologists contribute to the preservation of the soil resource and the advancement of information about the Earth's surface through their comprehension of the causes and magnitudes of soil variations.
 
• **Oceanography** is the study of all aspects of the ocean, covering topics from marine life and ecosystems to currents and waves, the movement of sediments, and seafloor geology.
 
• **Geomorphology** is the study of landforms and landform evolution, traditionally studied both qualitatively and quantitatively.
 
• **Phytogeography** is the study of the distribution of plants or taxonomic groups of plants, focusing on explaining the ranges of plants in terms of their origin, dispersal, and evolution.
